verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of email/SMS or printed receipt generation, formatting, or card-network compliance features. The only tangential reference (sumup-comm-1) describes a developer having to reverse-engineer the API to build a third-party receipt printer integration, implying no native, documented receipt-issuance capability is exposed. As a payments/POS product, receipt issuance is a fair axis, but nothing in the pack evidences it being delivered.
